dialogue.speaker: CAPTION
dialogue.text: Meridian. Every soul wears a number.

dialogue.speaker: NIL
dialogue.text: There's still six in the jar.

dialogue.speaker: BROTHER NOUGHT
dialogue.text: Every soul needs a number, child.

dialogue.speaker: BROTHER NOUGHT
dialogue.text: Then pick. The machine is listening.

dialogue.speaker: SYSTEM
dialogue.text: Choose a resonance. A personal number, not your health.

dialogue.speaker: VESPER
dialogue.text: I'll put it on your tab.

dialogue.speaker: GUS
dialogue.text: One for the road. Pick what you trust.

dialogue.speaker: VARRO
dialogue.text: NaN. Worth more than my whole street.

dialogue.speaker: VESPER
dialogue.text: They promised your sister an exemption?

dialogue.speaker: VESPER
dialogue.text: Three defences - or three rounds. Then you get it back.

dialogue.speaker: VESPER
dialogue.text: He took the score. Not your hand.

dialogue.speaker: NIL
dialogue.text: Then I can still stop him.

dialogue.speaker: VESPER
dialogue.text: He always says that like it's the first one.

dialogue.speaker: VESPER
dialogue.text: Six Auditors. Six Seal Digits. Then the Upper Gate.

dialogue.speaker: VESPER
dialogue.text: The last one's yours. You told the whole city.

dialogue.speaker: CAPTION
dialogue.text: THE REMAINDER - A beginning in the Tally.
